mapper.sql: p.promo_status = 1 AND p.promo_price IS NOT NULL AND (p.promo_start_time IS NULL OR p.promo_start_time <= NOW()) AND (p.promo_end_time IS NULL OR p.promo_end_time >= NOW())
CASE WHEN THEN p.promo_price ELSE p.price END
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.product_id AS "productId", c.quantity, c.checked, p.name AS "productName", AS price, p.price AS "basePrice", CASE WHEN THEN p.price ELSE p.original_price END AS "originalPrice", p.promo_price AS "promoPrice", p.promo_start_time AS "promoStartTime", p.promo_end_time AS "promoEndTime", CASE WHEN THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "promoActive", p.image_url AS "imageUrl", p.stock, p.status AS "productStatus", ( * c.quantity) AS subtotal FROM shopping_cart c JOIN product p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, checked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{checked})
mapper.update: UPDATE shopping_cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE shopping_cart SET checked = #{checked} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND checked = 1
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId}
